critical_code_review_comments: manufacturing_foundation.py — All 10 PMS families registered idempotently with `register(_pms(...))`, each inheriting FOUNDATION_ID. Clean single-source-of-truth pattern; improvement to Foundation propagates automatically. GOOD.
ukr_standard.py:44 domain_from_category — word-boundary regex (`\b`+re.escape(key)+`\b`) prevents false positives like 'ai' matching inside 'daily/train/sustains'. Fix is correct and defensive.

ukr_standard.py:150 migrate_all — Non-destructive: only writes when NOT (dry_run OR already_v11). `sample: migrated[:8]` intentionally capped; safe. Dedup of duplicate knowledge_titles appends kr_code — deterministic.
routers/manufacturing_standards.py — `require_super_admin` correctly gates the POST /ukr/migrate mutating endpoint; read endpoints use `get_current_user`. Constitutional privilege model honoured.
manufacturing_foundation.py:104 require_pms — Two-tier gate (existence THEN approval) with distinct error messages. Good UX.

manufacturing_foundation.py:131 build_manifest — PMF references UKR via ukr_id (never duplicates knowledge). `note` field explicitly states 'Knowledge is referenced, never duplicated'. Constitutional separation is enforced at the data-model level, not just documentation.

MINOR (informational): `/api/manufacturing/pms/{product_type}` uses product_type as the path segment (e.g. 'Flash Cards' for the Knowledge Card family). Callers who reason in product_family names will need a family→type mapping (or an accompanying /pms-by-family endpoint) — not a bug, but worth documenting.
